title: Mindset
author: Carol S. Dweck
blurb: Growth mindset as a practice, not a slogan.
description: Dweck contrasts fixed mindset (“this is who I am”) with growth mindset (“this is who I’m becoming”). The book is strongest when it shows how praise, failure, and challenge either shut learning down or open it up — at school, at work, and in relationships. A foundation text if you catch yourself treating ability as a finished product.
